name: Reinforced buckler
description: A buckler with an iron boss and rim. Smaller than your regrets, sturdier than your excuses.
notes: A fine buckler. Blocks as the wood-shield profile (no separate shield data yet). Weight 1.5 kg. Catalogue tier fine (economy doc, light class 35-60 x2.5). The economy doc has no shield band; priced as a helmet of the matching class. Authored for shop stock (mw-ju8.3); not for sale until a shop row stocks it (mw-ju8.5).
